blocks.text:
Anna: I am in my new apartment! Great! I live with Marsha. We’re roommates. I want to cook dinner. Hum. Is there a supermarket near here? Marsha knows. Marsha’s work number is 555-8986.
Man: Hello.
Anna: Hello. Is this Marsha? It is Anna.
Man: I am sorry. You have the wrong number.
Anna: Oh. Is this 555-8986?
Man: No. This is 555-8689.
Anna: Oh. Excuse me!
Man: Okay. ‘Bye.
Anna: One more time. 555-8986. Please be Marsha.
Marsha: Hello. This is Marsha.
Anna: Yes, Marsha. I want to cook dinner.
Marsha: Excuse me? Anna? Is that you?
Anna: Oh, yes. I am here!
Marsha: Good. You are there.
Anna: I want to find a supermarket.
Marsha: Oh, okay. The supermarket is at 1500 Irving Street. It is near the apartment.
Anna: Great! Goodbye!
Marsha: Goodbye, Anna.

questions.prompt: Which action helps Anna reach Marsha?
options: Go to the supermarket without calling.

Anna: Pete, hi! Hi, we are here!
Pete: Hi, Anna! Hi, Marsha!
Anna: Hi!
Pete: How are you two?
Marsha: I am great!
Anna: You know, Pete, I am new to D.C. The city is big.
Pete: Yeah. But you learn a little more every day. How’s the new apartment?
Anna: The new apartment is great! Let’s get coffee!
Marsha: Anna, do you have a pen?
Anna: Yes. I have a pen in my bag. I have a …
Pete: It is not a pen. It is a book. It is a big book.
Anna: Yes. Yes it is, Pete. I know I have a pen, though… I have a ....
Marsha: It is not a pen, Anna ... a toy?
Anna: I have a ....
Pete: And it is a pillow!
Anna: Pete, Marsha, I know I have a pen.
Marsha: Anna, it is a map.
Pete: Why do you have a map of the world?
Anna: Pete, Marsha. Now I know I have a pen.
Pete: And now you have a lamp.
Marsha: Anna.
Anna: I have a pen! Let’s get coffee!

goal.en: Follow what people are doing and distinguish an invitation from being busy now.
goal.zh-Hans: 理解正在进行的活动，分清现在正忙和稍后可以来访。
goal.zh-Hant: 理解正在進行的活動，分清現在正忙和稍後可以來訪。

teaching.en: Keep each activity with its speaker. Notice now, again and time phrases. “Maybe another time” postpones a visit; it does not invite you in now.
teaching.zh-Hans: 把活动和说话者对应，注意 now、again 和时间表达。“Maybe another time”表示改天或稍后，并不是现在可以进去。
teaching.zh-Hant: 把活動和說話者對應，注意 now、again 和時間表達。「Maybe another time」表示改天或稍後，並不是現在可以進去。

workedExample.en: If someone says “I am cooking. Come by this evening”, cooking is the current activity and evening is the visit time. Keep these details separate.
workedExample.zh-Hans: 如果有人说“I am cooking. Come by this evening”，cooking 是现在的活动，evening 是来访时间；把这两个细节分开。
workedExample.zh-Hant: 如果有人說「I am cooking. Come by this evening」，cooking 是現在的活動，evening 是來訪時間；把這兩個細節分開。

nextStep.en: On the next conversation, check the speaker and the time before deciding what to do.
nextStep.zh-Hans: 在下一段对话中，先确认说话者和时间，再决定该做什么。
nextStep.zh-Hant: 在下一段對話中，先確認說話者和時間，再決定該做什麼。

blocks.text:
Anna: Hi there! I’m Anna.
Anne: Hi, Anna. I’m Anne.
Anna: Nice to meet you. What are you doing?
Anne: Um, I’m writing.
Anna: You are writing! You are writing a lot!
Anna: (Spills papers) Oh! Oh dear.
Anne: No! No! That's okay.
Anna: I am sorry!
Anne: That’s okay. Really.
Anna: I am sorry!
Anne: Please. Please. Please stop. Please.
Anna: Sorry. Sorry.
Jonathan: (in the studio) “and people all around the world are waiting to hear news about the next president…”
Anna: Jonathan, hi! Remember me? I live in your building.
Jonathan: Oh. Uh. Hi, Anna.
Anna: What are you doing?
Jonathan: I am doing my show!
Anna: Oh, sorry. Are you recording?
Jonathan: Yes! And, now I have to record again!
Anna: Sorry. Have a good show.
Jonathan: Thank you.
Anna: Sorry.

questions.prompt: Match each co-worker with the activity stated in the conversation.

hints.en: Match names to present activities.
hints.zh-Hans: 把名字和正在进行的活动配对。
hints.zh-Hant: 把名字和正在進行的活動配對。

hints.en: Find “I’m writing” and the reply to “Are you recording?”
hints.zh-Hans: 找“I’m writing”和对“Are you recording?”的回答。
hints.zh-Hant: 找「I’m writing」和對「Are you recording?」的回答。

hints.en: I am plus an -ing form describes an activity happening now.
hints.zh-Hans: I am 加 -ing 形式表示正在进行的活动。
hints.zh-Hant: I am 加 -ing 形式表示正在進行的活動。

explanation.en: Anne says she is writing. Jonathan confirms he is recording and needs to record again. Neither is looking for a pen.
explanation.zh-Hans: Anne 说自己在写作；Jonathan 确认在录制，并需要重录。两人都没有在找笔。
explanation.zh-Hant: Anne 說自己在寫作；Jonathan 確認在錄製，並需要重錄。兩人都沒有在找筆。

questions.prompt: What does Jonathan say he has to do next?

hints.en: Find the action he says is necessary.
hints.zh-Hans: 找他说必须做的事。
hints.zh-Hant: 找他說必須做的事。

hints.en: Look at the sentence containing “have to”.
hints.zh-Hans: 看含有 have to 的句子。
hints.zh-Hant: 看含有 have to 的句子。

hints.en: Have to expresses a need; again means one more time.
hints.zh-Hans: have to 表示必须，again 表示再一次。
hints.zh-Hant: have to 表示必須，again 表示再一次。

explanations.en: He explicitly says he has to record again.
explanations.zh-Hans: 他明确说自己必须重录。
explanations.zh-Hant: 他明確說自己必須重錄。

explanations.en: Anne is writing, but Jonathan does not say he will write her papers.
explanations.zh-Hans: Anne 在写作，但 Jonathan 没有说要替她写。
explanations.zh-Hant: Anne 在寫作，但 Jonathan 沒有說要替她寫。

explanations.en: Anna mentions the building, but he says he must record again.
explanations.zh-Hans: Anna 提到他们住的楼；他说必须做的是重录。
explanations.zh-Hant: Anna 提到他們住的樓；他說必須做的是重錄。

options: Jonathan is recording his evening show.

hints.en: Distinguish now from another time.

hints.en: Find the sentence starting with “When”.

goal.en: Follow what people are doing and distinguish an invitation from being busy now.
goal.zh-Hans: 理解正在进行的活动，分清现在正忙和稍后可以来访。
goal.zh-Hant: 理解正在進行的活動，分清現在正忙和稍後可以來訪。

teaching.en: Keep each activity with its speaker. Notice now, again and time phrases. “Maybe another time” postpones a visit; it does not invite you in now.
teaching.zh-Hans: 把活动和说话者对应，注意 now、again 和时间表达。“Maybe another time”表示改天或稍后，并不是现在可以进去。
teaching.zh-Hant: 把活動和說話者對應，注意 now、again 和時間表達。「Maybe another time」表示改天或稍後，並不是現在可以進去。

workedExample.en: If someone says “I am cooking. Come by this evening”, cooking is the current activity and evening is the visit time. Keep these details separate.
workedExample.zh-Hans: 如果有人说“I am cooking. Come by this evening”，cooking 是现在的活动，evening 是来访时间；把这两个细节分开。
workedExample.zh-Hant: 如果有人說「I am cooking. Come by this evening」，cooking 是現在的活動，evening 是來訪時間；把這兩個細節分開。

nextStep.en: On the next conversation, check the speaker and the time before deciding what to do.
nextStep.zh-Hans: 在下一段对话中，先确认说话者和时间，再决定该做什么。
nextStep.zh-Hant: 在下一段對話中，先確認說話者和時間，再決定該做什麼。
